type WsStatus = 'connecting' | 'connected' | 'error'

interface NativeMessage {
  id:           number
  content:      string
  channel_type: string | null
  created_at:   string
}

const StatusDot = ({ status }: { status: WsStatus }) => {
  const color = status === 'connected' ? '#4ade80' : status === 'connecting' ? '#facc15' : '#f87171'
  return <View style={{ width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: color }} />
}

const ChannelCard = ({
  title, badge, badgeColor, description, status, count, msgs, onSend, footer,
}: {
  title:       string
  badge:       string
  badgeColor:  string
  description: string
  status:      WsStatus
  count:       number
  msgs:        NativeMessage[]
  onSend:      (val: string) => void
  footer?:     React.ReactNode
}) => {
  const [input, setInput] = useState('')

  const handleSend = () => {
    const val = input.trim()
    if (!val) return
    onSend(val)
    setInput('')
  }

  return (
    <View className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-neutral-100 overflow-hidden mb-4">
      <View className="px-4 py-3.5 border-b border-neutral-100">
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
            <View className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${badgeColor}`}>
              <Text className="text-white text-xs font-semibold">{badge}</Text>
            </View>
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-800">{title}</Text>
          </View>
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
            <StatusDot status={status} />
            <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-400">{status}</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-300"> · </Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-400">{count} rx</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-400 mt-1" numberOfLines={2}>{description}</Text>
      </View>

      <View className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-neutral-50 flex-row gap-2 items-center">
        <TextInput
          className="flex-1 bg-neutral-50 border border-neutral-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-neutral-900"
          placeholder="Type and send…"
          placeholderTextColor="#a3a3a3"
          value={input}
          onChangeText={setInput}
          onSubmitEditing={handleSend}
          returnKeyType="send"
          autoCorrect={false}
          autoCapitalize="none"
        />
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSend} activeOpacity={0.8} className="bg-neutral-900 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl">
          <Text className="text-white text-xs font-semibold">Send</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {footer && <View className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-neutral-50">{footer}</View>}

      {msgs.length === 0 ? (
        <View className="py-8 items-center">
          <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-300">No messages yet</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        msgs.slice(0, 20).map((m, i) => (
          <View key={i} className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-neutral-50 flex-row items-start gap-2">
            <Text className="flex-1 text-sm text-neutral-700">{m.content}</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-neutral-300 shrink-0">{m.created_at?.slice(11, 19)}</Text>
          </View>
        ))
      )}
    </View>
  )
}

import { useState } from '@lynx-js/react'

const IndexLynxPage = () => {
  const [name,      setName]      = useState('')
  const [email,     setEmail]     = useState('')
  const [message,   setMessage]   = useState('')
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false)

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (!name || !email || !message) return
    setSubmitted(true)
    setName(''); setEmail(''); setMessage('')
    setTimeout(() => setSubmitted(false), 3000)
  }

  return (
    <scroll-view className="flex-1 bg-neutral-50">
      {/* Header */}
      <view className="bg-white border-b border-neutral-200">
        <view className="px-6 py-4 flex-row items-center" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
          <text className="text-2xl">💻</text>
          <text className="font-semibold text-neutral-900">Portfolio</text>
        </view>
      </view>

      <view className="px-6 py-16" style={{ gap: 80 }}>
        {/* Hero */}
        <view className="items-center">
          <text className="text-5xl font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-4 text-center">Full-Stack Developer</text>
          <text className="text-lg text-neutral-600">Crafting digital experiences</text>
        </view>

        {/* Projects */}
        <view>
          <view className="flex-row items-center mb-8" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
            <text className="text-2xl font-semibold text-neutral-900">⭐ Projects</text>
          </view>
          <view className="flex-row flex-wrap" style={{ gap: 24 }}>
            {PROJECTS.map(p => (
              <view key={p.id} className="flex-1 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-neutral-200" style={{ overflow: 'hidden', minWidth: '30%' }}>
                <view className="h-32 bg-neutral-100 items-center justify-center">
                  <text className="text-5xl">{p.image}</text>
                </view>
                <view className="p-6">
                  <text className="text-lg font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-2">{p.title}</text>
                  <text className="text-sm text-neutral-600 mb-4">{p.description}</text>
                  <view className="flex-row flex-wrap mb-4" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                    {p.tags.map((t, i) => (
                      <text key={i} className="px-2 py-1 text-xs bg-neutral-100 text-neutral-600 rounded">{t}</text>
                    ))}
                  </view>
                  <text className="text-sm text-neutral-900 font-medium" bindtap={() => openURL(p.url)}>View ↗</text>
                </view>
              </view>
            ))}
          </view>
        </view>

        {/* Skills */}
        <view>
          <text className="text-2xl font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-12">Skills</text>
          <view className="flex-row flex-wrap" style={{ gap: 48 }}>
            {CATEGORIES.map(cat => (
              <view key={cat} className="flex-1" style={{ minWidth: '45%' }}>
                <text className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-6" style={{ letterSpacing: 1.5, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>{cat}</text>

                  {SKILLS.filter(s => s.category === cat).map((s, i) => (

                      <view className="flex-row justify-between mb-2">
                        <text className="text-sm text-neutral-700">{s.name}</text>
                        <text className="text-xs text-neutral-500">{s.proficiency}%</text>

                      <view className="h-2 bg-neutral-200 rounded-full">
                        <view className="h-full bg-neutral-900 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${s.proficiency}%` }} />
